name: 0067 - Gate-altitude skip pin + verified production artifact reads

jobs.title: Implement in-suite skip-pin enforcement and verified production artifact reads
jobs.objective: Implement the top two successor findings from workflow 0066's pre-merge review without re-deriving the ranked table. SLICE A - GATE ALTITUDE. Add an in-suite pytest hook in tests/conftest.py that enforces the skip-count pin only when KAYAKGEN_ENFORCE_SKIP_PIN=1 is set. Both gate scripts must export that env var. Derive the expected skip count from the OpenFOAM opt-in knobs: default gates with KAYAKGEN_OPENFOAM_SMOKE unset expect the documented OpenFOAM opt-in tests to skip; an explicit KAYAKGEN_OPENFOAM_SMOKE=1 run expects those tests to pass rather than skip. Do not trip partial pytest invocations. Update RELEASE_DISCIPLINE.md so requirement 1 records the env-knob design decision, and keep scripts/full-gate.sh as the mechanical pre-merge form. While touching the scripts, guard cd to the git root, anchor skip-summary parsing to pytest's final summary line, and harden non-numeric parse failures. Either keep the duplicated script pin or redesign tests/test_fast_gate_manifest.py if consolidating. SLICE B - VERIFIED READ ADOPTION. Route reachable production readers through verified ArtifactStore APIs when an ArtifactRef or hash-bearing record is available: kayakgen/search/compare.py, kayakgen/cli/runs_cli.py, and kayakgen/eval/cfd/job_store.py are the named call sites. Settle and document the design: prefer record-carried ArtifactRef fields where present; for legacy path-only records, build refs only when the record/index carries the expected SHA-256, otherwise record the remaining direct-read surface honestly in DRAFT.md. Harden FilesystemArtifactStore: wrap glob-branch read_bytes OSError and fall through to re-derive, try intact same-hash siblings before raising on a corrupt one, rehash equal-length write-side occupants before trusting them, reject absolute/outside relative_path joins, and export ArtifactIntegrityError in __all__. Add focused tests for every behavior changed. Optional cleanup only if it stays small: shared gated-compare staging helper and repair-tail extraction. Update CHANGELOG.md and DECISION_LOG.md if the verified-read adoption or gate-design decision needs a recorded row. Gate with focused tests, ruff, then scripts/full-gate.sh; verify the user-level ~/.local/share/kayakgen/index.sqlite remains empty/unchanged. Publish striatum/0067-gate-altitude-verified-reads/DRAFT.md with design decisions, shas/diffstat, tests run, remaining direct-read surfaces if any, and gate tail.

jobs.title: Review gate enforcement honesty and serve-only-verified adoption
jobs.objective: Review the 0067 draft with two primary lenses. First, gate enforcement honesty: bare full-suite pytest must fail on a wrong skip count when KAYAKGEN_ENFORCE_SKIP_PIN=1 is exported, but partial pytest invocations must not be punished. Confirm both gate scripts export the knob, derive expected skip count correctly from OpenFOAM opts, guard git-root cd, and parse only the final pytest summary line. Prove the hook fires by sabotaging the expected count in scratch. Second, serve-only-verified adoption: trace the named production readers and every FilesystemArtifactStore read return. Verify record-carried hashes are used where available, path-only legacy surfaces are either moved or explicitly recorded, corrupt same-hash siblings are skipped in favor of intact siblings, read OSErrors fall through, equal-length write-side occupants are rehashed, absolute relative_path refs are refused, and ArtifactIntegrityError is exported. Check scope first; any write outside the allowed paths is needs_revision. Run focused tests and scripts/full-gate.sh. Publish REVIEW.md before or alongside the long gate with verdict accept / accept_with_findings / needs_revision; never terminal reject.

jobs.title: Apply review findings and close workflow 0067
jobs.objective: Apply every must-fix finding from review within the original write scope. Do not broaden 0067 into deferred G7/G11 work. Refresh docs or counts if review/apply changes affected them. Write docs/workflows/0067-gate-altitude-verified-reads/OPERATOR_REPORT.md with landed items, design decisions, production read adoption coverage, remaining legacy path-only surfaces if any, tests/gates, and user-level index DB verification. Re-run scripts/full-gate.sh with heartbeats and publish striatum/0067-gate-altitude-verified-reads/SUMMARY.md. Leave the stack on the run branch for operator merge.
